name: Vampire - Legendary Resistance (3/Day) - Failures
description: Flavor text for failures a feature

results.text: A guttural snarl escapes the vampire’s throat as fate’s cruel hand slams down upon it.
The air crackles with static as the undead lord’s defiant will crumbles against the tide of destiny.
The scent of iron fills the air as the vampire’s resistance fails, its legendary power wavering for just a moment.
With a thunderous roar, the saving throw is shattered by an unseen force beyond the vampire’s control.
Dark whispers slither through the crypt as the vampire’s defiance falters against an ancient and malevolent will.
